map.输入半衰期 t½（秒），求衰变常数。: Enter the half-life t½ (in seconds) to get the decay constant.

map.C-14（th=5730年）等常数测算。: Compute constants such as C-14 (th = 5730 years).
map.若 th=1 天≈8.64e4s，则 λ≈8.02×10⁻⁶ s⁻¹，寿命越短: If th = 1 day ≈ 8.64e4 s, then λ ≈ 8.02×10⁻⁶ s⁻¹; the shorter the life, the larger λ.
map.λ 与 th 成反比？: Is λ inversely proportional to th?
map.是，λ=ln2/th，半衰期越长衰变越慢、λ 越小。: Yes. λ = ln2/th, so a longer half-life means slower decay and a smaller λ.
map.λ 单位为 s⁻¹（或 yr⁻¹，取决于 th 单位），表示单位时间衰变概率。: λ is in s⁻¹ (or yr⁻¹ depending on the unit of th) and expresses the decay probability per unit time.
map.衰变常数：λ = ln2 ÷ 半衰期 T₁/₂（1/s，半衰期按秒输入，ln2: Decay constant: λ = ln2 ÷ half-life T₁/₂ (1/s, with the half-life entered in seconds, ln2 = 0.693147…); linked cards: mean lifetime τ = 1 ÷ λ (s, falling back to 10⁻³⁰ when λ is extremely small to avoid division by zero), λ×10⁶ (in 10⁻⁶/s), half-life (s) echoed for cross-checking. Validation: non-empty valid-numeric guard for T₁/₂; entering 0 makes the division fall back to «—». Criteria: no fixed grading; λ is inversely proportional to T₁/₂, and τ ≈ 1.4427×T₁/₂.
